name: Thaumaturgy III
description:
Chances to miss reduced by 15%.
Attacks have a 40% chance to POISON the target for 1 turn. Striking enemies triggers Chemical Reactions:
• ABLAZE -> VAPORIZE: 100% INT magic burst to all enemies.
• FROZEN -> THERMAL SHOCK: Shatters freeze for +125% physical + 125% magical hybrid damage.

On death, POISONS, FREEZES, sets ABLAZE every enemy for 5 turns, STUNS them for 1 turn and confers ANOINTED to allies for 10 turns.

POISON: damage reduced by 20%
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn.
ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
STUN: the unit skips its turn
ANOINTED: This unit deals 25% increased damage.
